## The question

`scripts/query-options-erasure-baseline.json` grandfathers `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts` at **12** engine query-options `any`-erasures, per file, shrink-only in both dimensions: the key set only loses files (checked against the merge base with `main`), and a count that falls is ratcheted down in the same PR. `eslint.config.mjs` reads the same key set as the `ignores` of `query-options/no-any-erasure`, so a file outside it is linted at `error`. Read at `main` `49185cdb` (after cut 1), every one of the 12 counted sites is the options literal (argument 1) of an `engine.findOne` / `engine.find` / `engine.count` call carrying `context: SYSTEM_CTX`, closed by `} as any);`, and every one sits in a body the series still has to move (lines at `49185cdb`): `stampIdentitySource` 8819, 8830 · `refreshMustChangeCacheIfStale` 8972 · `refreshOrgMfaCacheIfStale` 9000 · `resolveUserAuthGates` 9151, 9158 · `assertPasswordNotReused` 9341 · `recordPasswordHistory` 9388 · `unlockUser` 9768, 9782 · `enforceSessionControls` 9829 · `enforceConcurrentCap` 9914. Sum 12 = the file's whole baseline count. (Claim `6351729156` reads 「6 of the file's 12」 in five of its sixteen hardening methods; the other 6 sit in `stampIdentitySource`, the two cache refreshers and `resolveUserAuthGates`, which that reading did not take; the 12 above are the file's full count, measured with the grandfathering lifted.) (The file's 13 other `{ context: SYSTEM_CTX } as any` sit on `engine.update(…)`'s third argument; `update` is not in `ENGINE_QUERY_READ_METHODS`, so the ratchet does not count them and they move freely.) Moving any of those nine bodies verbatim into a new module puts a counted site into a file with no key: `pnpm lint` goes red on the new module, and `pnpm check:query-options-erasure` refuses a new key. The card thread narrowed cut 2 to the erasure-free methods and stopped the later cuts on this fork:

- **A** (the card thread's recommendation) — one separate, small PR first drops the counted assertions in place and ratchets the baseline down (the rule's own prescription); the later cuts stay move-only.
- **B** — drop the casts inside the move cut and prove the cut by transpiled-JS identity instead of token identity; the cut is no longer a pure move.
- **C** — leave the nine methods in `auth-manager.ts` for good; the password / lockout / session-control / auth-gate seam stays fragmented.
